The SEGA Villains Stage DLC launch on April 3rd! Joe Musashi will battle classic SEGA Villains - Majima, the mad dog of Shimano from the Yakuza/Like a Dragon series; Dr. Eggman, the evil genius from the Sonic the Hedgehog series; and Death Adder, the ruthless giant from Golden Axe. 

This new villainous DLC includes:
5 stages
3 bosses (Majima, Dr. Eggman, and Death Adder)
3 ninpos
3 skins
6 music tracks inspired by each SEGA Villain IP
2 Boss Rush Modes featuring the new bosses

Wield the katana and obliterate all who stand in your way!

Available on PlayStation 4 & PlayStation 5
